description: Will it rain in Seattle during your event window. Event-window weather odds for Seattle: pass a start and end time (or omit them for the next six hours) and get rain probability and expected conditions across the window — built for scheduling decisions. Same shape as /v1/forecast/window with the Seattle coordinates built in. [HTTP: GET /v1/forecast/seattle/window · price $0.02 via x402 · docs https://x402-factory.com/docs/weather.forecast-window.seattle]

end.description: Window end (ISO-8601), ≤12h after start. Default: start + 6h.

start.description: Window start (ISO-8601). Default: the top of the next hour.

name: weather_forecast-window_seattle
